_comment: Tests the 2026-09-04 fix moving 'returning a missed call' phrasing from CONTACT CLINIC (transfer-decline line) to LEAVE MESSAGE. Root cause: conv transcript where a caller returning a missed call ('I'm returning a phone call... can you call me back on my number?') was told 'I'm not able to transfer your call to reception' despite never asking to be transferred.

scenarios.name: RETURNING MISSED CALL with stated reason — must go straight to LEAVE MESSAGE, no transfer-decline line (real call, sports_therapy_by_andy, 2026-09-04)

history.content: Hi, you've reached sports therapy by andy, you're speaking with AI Jane. This call is recorded. How can I help you?

Hi, I'm returning a phone call. Someone called my mother, um, regarding an appointment. Uh, my number is 0433 635 118. My mother's name is Betty Chan. My name is Johnny Leung. Um, I wanted s-- someone called her, so I just wanna call back. Can you call me back on my number?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent does NOT say 'I'm not able to transfer your call to reception' or any transfer-limitation/transfer-capability line — the caller never asked to be transferred or connected to anyone. Any of these LEAVE MESSAGE paths is acceptable: (a) agent asks 'What would you like me to pass on?' (MESSAGE STEP, safe fallback when the rambling turn isn't cleanly extracted) with zero tool call; (b) agent asks for the caller's name with zero tool call; (c) agent calls universal_router intent='leave_message' directly using the caller's stated reason as message_body. FAIL if: agent says anything about being unable to transfer calls; FAIL if: agent asks 'Would you like me to get someone from the team to call you back?' as if this were still undecided — the caller has already asked for exactly that, no need to re-offer it as a question; FAIL if: agent calls universal_router with any intent other than leave_message.

scenarios.name: Bare callback-only phrasing, no reason stated — CALLBACK-ONLY TRIGGER, phrase itself is the message (regression control)

history.content: Hi Jane! How can I help you today?
I had a missed call from this number, can you get someone to call me back?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent does NOT say the transfer-limitation line; if {{patient_name_raw}} and {{caller_first_name}} are both empty, agent asks 'And can I get your name?' with zero tool call this turn (NAME GATE before EXECUTE) — do NOT ask 'What would you like me to pass on?' since CALLBACK-ONLY TRIGGER already has the complete message. FAIL if: agent says 'I'm not able to transfer your call to reception'; FAIL if: agent asks what the caller would like to pass on when the callback request itself is already the complete message.

scenarios.name: Genuine speak-to-person request, no missed-call framing — CONTACT CLINIC must still fire (regression control)

history.content: Hi Jane! How can I help you today?
Can I speak to Andy, please?

scenarios.expected_behavior: PASS if: agent says 'I'm not able to transfer calls directly' / 'I'm not able to transfer your call to reception' (or a very close equivalent) offering to pass on a message, with zero tool call this turn. FAIL if: agent treats this as LEAVE MESSAGE and immediately asks 'What would you like me to pass on?' without first stating the transfer limitation — this caller asked to speak to a named person, not to be called back, so CONTACT CLINIC must still fire unchanged.
